description: Store a new memory with content, metadata, and automatic vector embedding. Use this to save information, decisions, patterns, or knowledge for later semantic retrieval.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the writing agent for multi-agent attribution

content.description: The text content to store as a memory

department.description: Department (e.g., legal, engineering, hr, sales, finance)

document_type.description: Type of document (e.g., contract, policy, code, incident, decision)

expires_at.description: Full ISO-8601 expiration timestamp, e.g. 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z (memory auto-excluded from search after this)

importance_score.description: Explicit importance 0-1 (governance/criticality). When omitted it is derived from content; min_importance filters operate on this value.

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

on_conflict.description: Write policy when a near-match exists. "add" (default): insert as new, except an exact duplicate is skipped (NOOP) — identical to prior behaviour. "update": merge content into the existing match (append + re-embed + version bump). "supersede": retire (invalidate) the conflicting match and add this as the current one.

source.description: Origin of the content (e.g., file path, URL, system name)

verification_detail.description: Free text: how/when/by-what the fact was verified (e.g. "checked live UAT DB 2026-06-18").

verification_tier.description: How well this fact is verified: source_verified > tool_verified > asserted > unverified. Lowers groundedness for unverified claims. Omit ⇒ neutral.

volatility.description: Override the auto-derived volatility class. Omit to auto-classify from content + document_type (volatile deploy/status facts warn sooner on recall).

name: memory_store
